channel.title: Use & Like: app news
channel.description: What changed in the apps you use, in our own words, with what it means for you and what to do about it.

item.title: YouTube TV support scam: fake phone number on Google cost a viewer thousands
item.description: A YouTube TV viewer in North Carolina lost several thousand dollars after calling a fake support number found on Google, the McDowell County Sheriff's Office says. The caller was told to buy Lowe's gift cards.

item.title: BabyBackup turns two phones or iPads into a baby monitor
item.description: BabyBackup makes a baby monitor from two devices you already own: one stays with your baby, you keep the other and listen. It was #10 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: ImagineSleep helps you fall asleep with the cognitive shuffle
item.description: ImagineSleep is built around the cognitive shuffle, a bedtime technique where you picture unrelated everyday things one at a time; you build the list yourself. It was #30 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Packed for It combines trip planning and packing lists
item.description: Packed for It keeps a cruise, flight, road trip or RV trip in one place, with people, pets, routes, stays, documents, weather and packing details connected. It was #25 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Calendaria shows your whole year as one scrolling calendar list
item.description: Calendaria lays out your calendar from January to December as one continuous list, with the days that matter standing out and their main event next to the date. It was #39 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Stellar Sky shows only the stars you can really see
item.description: Hold your phone to the sky and Stellar draws about 200 stars you can actually pick out with your own eyes, each one named. It was #44 among paid Reference apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: PocketMic turns your iPhone into a karaoke mic with a Bluetooth speaker
item.description: PocketMic Karaoke lets you sing along to karaoke videos on YouTube or any song and hear your voice through a Bluetooth speaker with echo and reverb. It was #64 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Gardener's Pocket Book makes a planting calendar from your ZIP code
item.description: Enter your ZIP code and Gardener's Pocket Book finds your USDA hardiness zone and builds a month-by-month planting calendar for nearly 200 vegetables, herbs, fruits, flowers, trees and shrubs. It was #33 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Scratchpost is cat TV with a locked screen
item.description: Scratchpost plays loops like a lizard darting across sand or birds at birdhouses for your cat, with a locked mode so taps and swipes do nothing. It was #65 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: OTO Camera takes finished photos with almost nothing to set
item.description: OTO lets you pick a look and take the photo; each shot is developed in that look, with its own colour, tone and texture, and saved to your library finished. It was #63 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Unscripted turns an iPhone or iPad into a party video booth
item.description: Put Unscripted on a stand and tap Go Live: guests answer questions on camera, take photos and leave messages for the host. It was #92 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Bargue Drawing Course teaches drawing the 19th-century way
item.description: Bargue Drawing Course walks you through the 196 plates of Charles Bargue's classic drawing course in order, from simple profiles to full heads and figures. It was #78 among paid Education apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: FormWright 3D: modeling, sculpting and animation on iPad and iPhone
item.description: FormWright 3D brings 3D modeling, sculpting, painting and animation together on iPad and iPhone in one local project. It was #23 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 6 November.

item.title: Amazon Prime adds Uber Eats: free delivery on food orders over $25
item.description: Amazon Prime members in the US can now order restaurant takeout from Uber Eats inside the Amazon app or website, with no delivery fee on orders of $25 or more. No Uber account is needed.

item.title: Android Auto not working for calls: it keeps asking who to call
item.description: Some Pixel and Galaxy owners say Android Auto keeps asking "Who do you want to call?" even after they say a contact's name, for calls and texts. Reports go back to early October.

item.title: Wi-Fi and mobile data not working after One UI 9 update on some Galaxy phones
item.description: Some Galaxy owners report Wi-Fi that keeps disconnecting, mobile data that won't connect, or a SIM card that isn't detected after the One UI 9 update. Samsung hasn't announced a fix.

item.title: Claude Personal Finance: connect your bank and ask where your money went
item.description: Anthropic's Claude has a new Personal Finance tool: you connect bank and credit card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about your spending. Access is read-only, so Claude can't move your money.

item.title: Lyft Go replaces Lyft Pink: $9.99 a month with DoorDash DashPass
item.description: Lyft's new Lyft Go subscription costs $9.99 a month or $96 a year, includes DoorDash's DashPass, and gives 8% of each ride back as credits, up to $40 a month. It launched in the US on 5 November with a one-month free trial.

item.title: Instagram Edits video editor now on Mac, free with 4K export
item.description: Instagram released Edits for Mac, its free video editor, with a multi-track timeline, keyframes, color grading tools, 4K export without a watermark and direct publishing to Instagram.

item.title: Fake ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps on GitHub install malware
item.description: Check Point found fake "ChatGPT" and "Claude" desktop apps offered on GitHub pages that install a crypto miner and a loader for more malware on Windows PCs. Some of the pages showed up in Google's top results.

item.title: TikTok Shop gets its own app in four Asian countries
item.description: TikTok quietly launched a separate TikTok Shop app in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines, on iPhone and Android, with shopping through live streams and short videos.

item.title: CleanMyMac can now clean up your Gmail inbox and Chrome tabs
item.description: MacPaw added Email Cleanup and Browser Care to CleanMyMac: delete Gmail mail in batches by sender, category, year or size and unsubscribe from several lists at once, and see which Chrome tabs use the most memory.

item.title: Spotify comes to United Airlines seatback screens with Starlink
item.description: United Airlines is rolling out a Spotify app on its seatback screens, where you sign in to your own account and stream your playlists and podcasts in flight over Starlink Wi-Fi.

item.title: PhotoUnlocked adds Portrait and Photographic Styles editing to older photos
item.description: PhotoUnlocked prepares photos you shared, downloaded or took with extra editing data, so you can use Portrait, Photographic Styles and Texture adjustments on them in Apple Photos. It was #16 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: Satisfy turns the iPhone Duo's hinge into 11 fidget toys
item.description: Satisfy is a box of eleven tactile toys for the iPhone Duo, like a bubble wrap sheet, that react to opening and closing the phone with sound and haptics. It was #3 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: Pilot Live Map: tap a plane overhead to see where it's going
item.description: Pilot is a live map of planes, nearby emergency incidents from official services and space stations, worldwide; spot a plane and look it up with a tap. It was #56 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: 4perf is a camera app with Night Boost for low light
item.description: 4perf has automatic exposure that adjusts from day to night, manual controls a gesture away, and Night Boost, which stacks a burst into one clean low-light photo. It was #28 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: Fold & Squish recreates the folded butterfly painting from school
item.description: In Fold & Squish you paint on half a page, fold it, rub it and peel it open to a mirror-image print; the paint is thick, wet and mixes. It was #18 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: MyPlantMap maps your garden plants on satellite images
item.description: MyPlantMap lets gardeners and homeowners catalog, track and plan plants directly on high-resolution satellite images of their property. It was #37 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: Your Total Calories shows active and resting calories as one number
item.description: Your Total Calories adds up the active and resting calories your body burns into one number on your Apple Watch, without a big dashboard. It was #84 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: Interteno is a new Plex player for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
item.description: Interteno is an app for your own Plex media server that combines Plex video and Plexamp-style music, with an Apple Watch app, CarPlay and widgets. It was #90 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 5 November.

item.title: Google Find Hub now warns you when you leave a tracker tag behind
item.description: Google's Find Hub on Android can now notify you when a tracker tag is separated from your phone. It's showing up for Chipolo trackers and the Moto Tag in version 3.1.787 for US and European users.

item.title: YouTube moves the Subscriptions tab off the bottom bar
item.description: YouTube's new app design on Android and iPhone takes the Subscriptions tab out of the bottom bar and puts it in a swipe header at the top. Shorts and the Upload button take its place below.

item.title: WhatsApp stops working on iPhones below iOS 15.5 on 30 November
item.description: From 30 November 2026, WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business need iOS 15.5 or newer. iPhones on iOS 15.0 to 15.4 lose access unless they update, and WhatsApp is sending notifications about it.

item.title: ChatGPT can now make animated GIFs
item.description: ChatGPT can turn a text prompt or an uploaded photo into an animated GIF, then let you change its speed, edit single frames and share it. It comes with OpenAI's new Images 2.6 model.

item.title: Oboe offers a feed of puzzles instead of endless scrolling
item.description: Oboe is an endless feed of interactive games and puzzles, meant to replace mindless scrolling. It was #40 among free Education apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: Bare is a shopping list that sorts items by store aisle
item.description: Bare is a simple shopping list: type an item and it goes into the right store section, like Produce or Dairy, so the list follows your way through the store. It was #22 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: Inward Photo brings back old photos from your phone, offline
item.description: Inward is a private, offline way to browse the thousands of photos and videos already on your phone, with a shuffled feed and other views; no account or uploads. It was #22 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: Post Club is a little typewriter for writing notes and letters
item.description: Post Club lets you pick a typewriter, feed in paper and type a birthday wish, a thank-you or a hello with clicking keys, then pull the page out to send it. It was #14 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: Daypond: focus timer and breathing beside a koi pond
item.description: Daypond has a 1-60 minute focus timer, breathing sessions and wind-down sessions next to an illustrated koi pond, with seven- and thirty-day charts. It was #23 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: One Cent Start gives you one short reading each morning
item.description: One Cent Start opens each morning to one page: the date, a short reflection you can read in under a minute and a simple meditation, for all 366 days of the year. It was #41 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: Plop Browser lets websites fill the whole iPhone screen
item.description: Plop is a browser that keeps the address bar and buttons hidden until you double-tap or tap with two fingers, so pages fill the screen. It was #49 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: iOS 27.3: Apple will check iCloud public links for harmful content
item.description: From iOS 27.3, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3, files and photos you share from iCloud with "Anyone with the link" will be checked by Apple for harmful content, a new support document says.

item.title: Siri AI no longer needs a waitlist on iOS 27
item.description: Apple's support page now says turning on Siri AI starts the download right away; a waitlist is used only at times of high demand. Before, everyone joined a waitlist first.

item.title: Hacked websites attacked out-of-date iPhones and Android phones
item.description: Security firm Sekoia found websites in the US, Ukraine, the Czech Republic and Bulgaria that silently attacked visitors' phones with known flaws, with no click needed. It links the campaign to the Russian group APT29.

item.title: CameraStamp shoots through modeled film stocks in real time
item.description: CameraStamp lets you shoot photos through modeled film stocks and old TV tube cameras, each with its own grain and colour, and saves what you see straight to your library. It was #77 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: Weather, Actually gives you the forecast in plain words
item.description: Weather, Actually explains the forecast in plain words, with three detail levels from "Super basic" to "Nerd", and shows your state's weather in 3D. It was #36 among paid Weather apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: LifeSize prints any photo as a big poster on normal paper
item.description: LifeSize turns photos, pets and drawings into large cutouts and posters printed on ordinary printer paper: pick a size, see the page count, follow the numbered sections. It was #56 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: MyPitStop tracks car maintenance for up to seven vehicles
item.description: MyPitStop keeps up to seven cars in a garage list, with mileage and one maintenance list for oil changes, fluids, checks and your own tasks. It was #79 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 4 November.

item.title: Happy Camper Checklist builds your camping packing list
item.description: Happy Camper Checklist makes a packing list from your trip type and crew, or from a library of grouped items, and lets you print and share it. It was #63 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
